Entries.Original: You will be fighting simulated Cancers again today.
Fighting in the arena?
Hell yeah, bring it on!|Is not what I'm gonna say, because I'm not some easily-excited kid|Is what I would say if I weren't, in fact, totally hyped!
Hell yeah, bring it on!
Same! I'm psyched! Brace yerself for a psychic smackdown!
You two said the exact same thing yesterday, you know.
You're all so thirsty for blood.
Is not what I'm gonna say, because I'm not some easily-excited kid.
You didn't say anything, though.
Yeah, I just thought "Hell yeah, bring it on!" internally.
Is what I would say if I weren't, in fact, totally hyped!
Humor me. Tell me everything that was going through your head.
"Hell yeah, bring it on!" followed by "Is not what I'm gonna say, because I'm not some easily-excited kid." followed by "Is what I would say if I weren't, in fact, totally hyped!"
Ahem.
ARE YOU A DUM-DUM?!
You're way too good at making people angry.
Also, please keep ALL of your internal monologue internal. Unless you're trying to get locked up in the loony bin.
Nanase, I trust you can handle the rest.
Alright.
Today's opponents are even more formidable than yesterday's.
Even if you break their shell, it may be restored with time.
Therefore, please conserve your power so you may eliminate the enemy immediately after destroying its shell.
Wow! It's like a video game!
No, we're talking military tactics. Get serious—your life is on the line here.
Conserve our power?
Like I need some lame ol' tactic like that...all I need's my psychic powers!
Tactics are exactly what you need. When have these psychic powers of yours EVER been useful in combat?
Today's training session will also have a set clear time. Work to claim victory quickly.
Everyone, please hold up your mePads and recite your Seraph Codes!
